worldcombat.skill.recycle.summary: While empty-handed, restore one held item you actually consumed. One receipt recovers one item with its components, then is spent.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.use.0: Regrow a berry eaten during the fight
worldcombat.skill.recycle.use.1: Restore a berry you actually ate
worldcombat.skill.recycle.use.2: Put an item back in your hands after it runs out
worldcombat.skill.recycle.description.0: Convergence range %1$s blocks (it only sizes this step; it does not search the ground for drops).
worldcombat.skill.recycle.description.1: Bend down to gather for %1$s, %2$s to gather yourself after the item forms, and a %3$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.description.2: It restores exactly the item a real consumption left behind, with its components; recovering one item spends it, a refused write retains it.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.timing: Self-cast; after %1$s seconds of preparation it costs %3$s PP to recycle, then %2$s seconds to gather yourself and a %4$s second cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.growth.0: At level %1$s the convergence range rises to %2$s blocks and the cooldown becomes %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.growth.1: At level %1$s the convergence range rises to %2$s blocks.
